title: Pantheon ApprovalDecision
description: First-class governance object that records whether an artifact / strategy / allocation is approved for the next lifecycle step. Shared by promotion and evolution planes.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this approval decision.

target_type.description: The type of object being approved. Must match a valid governance target.

target_id.description: The ID of the target object (e.g., registry_id, evolution_proposal_id).

target_version.description: The version or immutable snapshot key of the target object at the time of this decision.

decision.description: The outcome of the approval decision. Required once the object reaches decided.

decision_state.description: Lifecycle state of this decision object itself.

actor_role.description: The role of the actor making this decision. Must be authorized for the target type and risk level.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor (persona_id, operator_id, or system component) that made this decision.

rationale.description: Human-readable rationale for the decision. Required once the object reaches decided.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be satisfied for approved_with_conditions decisions. Empty or absent for approved/rejected.

risk_level.description: Risk level of the target. Determines which actor_role is authorized to decide.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence referenced to support this decision.

superseded_by.description: decision_id of a newer decision that supersedes this one.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this decision was created (proposed state).

decided_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the decision was finalized (decided state).

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp. After this time, the decision is no longer valid for promotion.

capital_pool_id.description: Optional: the capital pool this approval applies to. If absent, approval is pool-agnostic.

persona_id.description: Optional: the persona this approval applies to. If absent, approval is persona-agnostic.

tenant_id.description: Required tenant scope that owns this approval decision.

owner_user_id.description: Required user-private scope that owns this approval decision.

proposal_id.description: Governed proposal bound to this approval, when applicable.

session_id.description: Training or execution session bound to this approval.

candidate_digest.description: Content digest of the candidate object.

proof_digest.description: Content digest of the evaluation proof.
